faces.name: Sheoldred
faces.oracleText:
Menace
When Sheoldred enters, each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature or planeswalker of their choice.
{4}{B}: Exile Sheoldred, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery and only if an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard.

faces.name: The True Scriptures
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter.)
I — For each opponent, destroy up to one target creature or planeswalker that player controls.
II — Each opponent discards three cards, then mills three cards.
III — Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control. Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield (front face up).

faces.name: Sheoldred's Assimilator
faces.oracleText:
Menace
Whenever Sheoldred's Assimilator enters or attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard. If a card is exiled this way, you may conjure a duplicate of that card into the top five cards of your library at random.

faces.name: Sheoldred's Edict
faces.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.
• Each opponent sacrifices a creature token of their choice.
• Each opponent sacrifices a planeswalker of their choice.

faces.name: Sheoldred's Headcleaver
faces.oracleText:
Menace
Toxic 2 (Players dealt combat damage by this creature also get two poison counters.)

faces.name: Sheoldred's Restoration
faces.oracleText:
Kicker {2}{W} (You may pay an additional {2}{W} as you cast this spell.)
Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. If this spell was kicked, you gain life equal to that card's mana value. Otherwise, you lose that much life.
Exile Sheoldred's Restoration.

faces.name: Sheoldred's Terror
faces.oracleText: Destroy target creature not originally printed in an Argentum expansion. (Mirrodin, Darksteel, Fifth Dawn, Scars of Mirrodin, Mirrodin Besieged, New Phyrexia, and Phyrexia: All Will Be One are Argentum expansions. Argentum is Karn's original name for that plane, now you know!)

faces.name: Sheoldred, Whispering One
faces.oracleText:
Swampwalk (This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Swamp.)
At the beginning of your upkeep, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, that player sacrifices a creature of their choice.

faces.name: Sheoldred, the Apocalypse
faces.oracleText:
Deathtouch
Whenever you draw a card, you gain 2 life.
Whenever an opponent draws a card, they lose 2 life.
